evidence.reason: `_review` places the same `rows` list into `requested_scope`, `input_scope`, and `reviewed_scope`, and `_changed`/`_regenerated` uses `deepcopy`, which preserves that shared-reference aliasing. An in-place scope mutation therefore also changes `requested_scope`, causing the requested-scope digest check to reject the vector before the intended exceedance check. Each scope needs an independent copy and the generated vectors must be regenerated.
